shared_elements: single dominant anthropomorphic figure on a tall vertical monument
elaborate multi-tiered headdress covering the top of the head
belt or sash across the waist with hanging apron/loincloth
circular disc-like element (medallion / round object at the figure's side)
dense low-relief surface detail of costume elements
justification: Both depict a single richly costumed human figure filling a tall vertical monument, head crowned by a broad multi-tiered headdress, with a pectoral ornament, a belt with hanging apron below, and a circular disc-like element in the composition, rendered in dense, schematic low relief. The biggest differences are that B shows the figure in strict profile holding an upright staff and is framed by ordered columns of rectangular glyph-like signs plus a subsidiary small figure at lower left, whereas A is a rigidly frontal, symmetrical, sculptural figure with no sign-columns, no held implement and no secondary figure.
